units.summaryEn: Worked example, not a 615A protocol action.

units.summaryEn: Hardware receiver tests are outside protocol CRS.
units.summaryZh: 硬件接收测试不在协议 CRS 内。

units.summaryEn: APIM is not an actor obligation.
units.summaryZh: APIM 不是参与者义务。

units.clauseTitleEn: Deterministic Ethernet extensions live in Part 7
units.summaryEn: P2 limitations already record that AFDX deterministic extensions are in Part 7. Ordinary Ethernet and AFDX stay separate. Leaf coverage emitted this Package B increment; this is not independent RG approval.
units.summaryZh: P2 限制已记录 AFDX 确定性扩展在第 7 部分。普通以太网与 AFDX 保持分离。本执行包 B 已发出叶覆盖；这不是独立 RG 批准。

units.clauseTitleEn: Physical-layer delay is not a 615A operation deadline
units.summaryEn: Link budgets and reference-plane timing must not be rewritten as 615A FIND 2 s / 3 s or status-file deadlines.
units.summaryZh: 链路预算与参考面时序不得改写为 615A FIND 2 秒/3 秒或状态文件期限。

units.summaryEn: Completing this bounded audit does not mark the Ethernet physical-link capability established.
units.summaryZh: 完成本有界审计并不把以太网物理链路能力标为已建立。

units.summaryEn: Front matter identifies 664P3-1.
units.summaryZh: 扉页标识 664P3-1。

units.summaryEn: Existing NET-P3-SCOPE. Interoperability across compliant/profiled is not automatic. Current instance remains Compliant. Leaf coverage emitted this Package B increment; this is not independent RG approval.
units.summaryZh: 已有 NET-P3-SCOPE。Compliant/Profiled 之间互操作性不自动成立。当前实例保持 Compliant。本执行包 B 已发出叶覆盖；这不是独立 RG 批准。

units.clauseTitleEn: Document precedence and RFC option restriction
units.summaryEn: Existing NET-P3-PRECEDENCE. P3 restricts RFC options inside its profile. This is not a licence to drop 615A TFTP option rules. Leaf coverage emitted this Package B increment; this is not independent RG approval.
units.summaryZh: 已有 NET-P3-PRECEDENCE。P3 在其 profile 内限制 RFC 选项。这不是取消 615A TFTP 选项规则的许可。本执行包 B 已发出叶覆盖；这不是独立 RG 批准。

units.clauseTitleEn: Internet services other than 615A data loader
units.summaryEn: Broadcast, multicast, diagnostics, routing, FTP, telnet, HTTP, DNS, SNMP and remote access are not 615A protocol operations.
units.summaryZh: 广播、组播、诊断、路由、FTP、Telnet、HTTP、DNS、SNMP 与远程访问不是 615A 协议操作。

units.summaryEn: P3 names 615A data loading as a file-transfer service on the aircraft internet. It does not replace 615A operation definitions. Leaf coverage emitted this Package B increment; this is not independent RG approval.
units.summaryZh: P3 将 615A 数据加载列为航空互联网上的文件传输服务，并不取代 615A 操作定义。本执行包 B 已发出叶覆盖；这不是独立 RG 批准。

units.summaryEn: Existing NET-P3-TFTP. Base TFTP cites option RFCs; DL-TFTP implementation details refer back to 615A. Citing P3 does not bind every TFTP option RFC to every CRS row. Leaf coverage emitted this Package B increment; this is not independent RG approval.
units.summaryZh: 已有 NET-P3-TFTP。基础 TFTP 引用选项 RFC；DL-TFTP 实现细节回引 615A。引用 P3 并不把每个 TFTP 选项 RFC 绑到每条 CRS。本执行包 B 已发出叶覆盖；这不是独立 RG 批准。

units.summaryEn: Other application protocols are not 615A dataloading.
units.summaryZh: 其他应用协议不是 615A 数据加载。

units.summaryEn: 615A uses UDP/TFTP, not TCP.
units.summaryZh: 615A 使用 UDP/TFTP，不使用 TCP。

units.clauseTitleEn: UDP minimum transport and profiled table
units.summaryEn: Existing NET-P3-UDP-RULE/TABLE. Compliant path keeps UDP. Profiled X/E markings are unselected and must not weaken 615A. Leaf coverage emitted this Package B increment; this is not independent RG approval.
units.summaryZh: 已有 NET-P3-UDP-RULE/TABLE。Compliant 路径保持 UDP。未选择的 Profiled X/E 标记不得削弱 615A。本执行包 B 已发出叶覆盖；这不是独立 RG 批准。

units.summaryEn: Existing NET-P3-IP-RULE/TABLE/FRAGMENT/MTU. Profiled reassembly deviations cannot erase the 615A Data Loader fragmentation/reassembly obligation. MTU is packet sizing, not a 615A deadline. Leaf coverage emitted this Package B increment; this is not independent RG approval.
units.summaryZh: 已有 NET-P3-IP-RULE/TABLE/FRAGMENT/MTU。Profiled 重组偏差不能抹去 615A 数据加载器的分片/重组义务。MTU 是报文尺寸，不是 615A 期限。本执行包 B 已发出叶覆盖；这不是独立 RG 批准。

units.summaryEn: IPv6 is not the current 615A instance network.
units.summaryZh: IPv6 不是当前 615A 实例网络。

units.summaryEn: IPsec is not a 615A dataloading obligation.
units.summaryZh: IPsec 不是 615A 数据加载义务。

units.summaryEn: Existing NET-P3-ARP. Dynamic vs static mapping is a deployment choice with a named selector (integrator), not UNRESOLVED silence. Leaf coverage emitted this Package B increment; this is not independent RG approval.
units.summaryZh: 已有 NET-P3-ARP。动态与静态映射是带具名选择者（集成商）的部署选择，不是无说明的 UNRESOLVED。本执行包 B 已发出叶覆盖；这不是独立 RG 批准。

units.summaryEn: SICS/PICS examples are not leaf CRS and do not select Profiled exceptions.
units.summaryZh: SICS/PICS 示例不是叶 CRS，也不选择 Profiled 例外。

units.summaryEn: IPv6 example attachment is unused.
units.summaryZh: IPv6 示例附件不使用。

units.summaryEn: Glossary only.
units.summaryZh: 仅词汇表。

units.summaryEn: Back matter is not a 615A action.
units.summaryZh: 后文不是 615A 动作。

units.clauseTitleEn: P3-1 is a historical candidate edition
units.summaryEn: Existing NET-ISSUE-EDITION. Receipt of P3-1 is not a claim that it is the latest published Part 3.
units.summaryZh: 已有 NET-ISSUE-EDITION。收到 P3-1 并不声称它是最新发布的第 3 部分。

openIssues.noteEn: IPv4/UDP host communication remains NOT-ESTABLISHED. This audit does not close NET-ISSUE-RFC1122.
openIssues.noteZh: IPv4/UDP 主机通信仍为 NOT-ESTABLISHED。本审计不关闭 NET-ISSUE-RFC1122。

units.summaryEn: Front matter identifies 664P7 base edition.
units.summaryZh: 扉页标识 664P7 基础版。

units.summaryEn: Existing NET-P7-SCOPE. Applies only when 615A is carried over AFDX. Current Compliant Ethernet instance stays inactive for these units. Leaf coverage emitted this Package B increment; this is not independent RG approval.
units.summaryZh: 已有 NET-P7-SCOPE。仅当 615A 承载于 AFDX 时适用。当前 Compliant 以太网实例对这些单元保持未激活。本执行包 B 已发出叶覆盖；这不是独立 RG 批准。

units.clauseTitleEn: Overview: switched Ethernet, scalability, ordinal integrity, performance
units.summaryEn: System overview. Network performance numbers are not 615A operation deadlines. Leaf coverage emitted this Package B increment; this is not independent RG approval.
units.summaryZh: 系统概述。网络性能数字不是 615A 操作期限。本执行包 B 已发出叶覆盖；这不是独立 RG 批准。

units.clauseTitleEn: End-system: VL, BAG, jitter, MAC constraints
units.summaryEn: End-system VL/BAG/jitter are AFDX deployment obligations if AFDX is chosen. They do not rewrite TFTP/615A operations. Existing NET-P7-TFTP/IP/ADDRESS/PERFORMANCE regions inspect this surface. Leaf coverage emitted this Package B increment; this is not independent RG approval.
units.summaryZh: 若选择 AFDX，端系统 VL/BAG/抖动是部署义务。它们不改写 TFTP/615A 操作。已有 NET-P7-TFTP/IP/ADDRESS/PERFORMANCE 区域检查该表面。本执行包 B 已发出叶覆盖；这不是独立 RG 批准。

units.summaryEn: Existing NET-P7-SWITCH. Switch behaviour is not proved by ordinary Ethernet tests. Leaf coverage emitted this Package B increment; this is not independent RG approval.
units.summaryZh: 已有 NET-P7-SWITCH。交换机行为不能用普通以太网试验证明。本执行包 B 已发出叶覆盖；这不是独立 RG 批准。

units.summaryEn: System integration issues for AFDX, not 615A FIND semantics. Leaf coverage emitted this Package B increment; this is not independent RG approval.
units.summaryZh: AFDX 系统集成问题，不是 615A FIND 语义。本执行包 B 已发出叶覆盖；这不是独立 RG 批准。

units.summaryEn: AFDX frame/data format is deployment-conditional. Leaf coverage emitted this Package B increment; this is not independent RG approval.
units.summaryZh: AFDX 帧/数据格式为部署条件。本执行包 B 已发出叶覆盖；这不是独立 RG 批准。

units.clauseTitleEn: IP/ICMP, UDP and TCP profile provisions
units.summaryEn: Existing NET-P7-IP. AFDX IP/UDP profile does not replace RFC identity or 615A TFTP rules. TCP remains unused by 615A. Leaf coverage emitted this Package B increment; this is not independent RG approval.
units.summaryZh: 已有 NET-P7-IP。AFDX 的 IP/UDP profile 不取代 RFC 身份或 615A TFTP 规则。615A 仍不使用 TCP。本执行包 B 已发出叶覆盖；这不是独立 RG 批准。

units.summaryEn: Existing NET-P7-EXAMPLE. Example only.
units.summaryZh: 已有 NET-P7-EXAMPLE。仅为示例。

units.summaryEn: 429 mapping is outside 615A dataloading.
units.summaryZh: 429 映射不在 615A 数据加载内。

units.summaryEn: Informative mapping; 615A Appendix E remains the 615A-side pointer. Leaf coverage emitted this Package B increment; this is not independent RG approval.
units.summaryZh: 信息性映射；615A 侧指针仍是附录 E。本执行包 B 已发出叶覆盖；这不是独立 RG 批准。

units.clauseTitleEn: 615A Appendix E points to P7; P7 does not replace 615A operations
units.summaryEn: Reading 615A Appendix E is not a substitute for this P7 body audit. Conversely, P7 does not redefine FIND/UPLOAD/DOWNLOAD.
units.summaryZh: 阅读 615A 附录 E 不能代替本次 P7 正文审计。反之，P7 也不重定义 FIND/UPLOAD/DOWNLOAD。

units.summaryEn: 615A already allows 664 Part 4 address rules or integrator-identified requirements. 664-4 is not in this PR source set. The alternative is not a forced purchase and does not auto-activate AFDX.
units.summaryZh: 615A 已允许 664 第 4 部分地址规则或集成商指明的要求。664-4 不在本 PR 来源集合。该替代不是强制采购，也不自动激活 AFDX。

units.summaryEn: Existing NET-ISSUE-AID. No AID edition is selected this PR.
units.summaryZh: 已有 NET-ISSUE-AID。本 PR 未选择 AID 版次。

openIssues.noteEn: No AFDX hardware test environment is created. Software Ethernet experiments do not prove AFDX guarantees.
openIssues.noteZh: 未建立 AFDX 硬件试验环境。软件以太网试验不能证明 AFDX 保证。

units.summaryEn: UDP is the datagram service under 615A TFTP. Delivery and duplicate protection are not guaranteed by UDP itself. Leaf coverage emitted this Package B increment; this is not independent RG approval.
units.summaryZh: UDP 是 615A TFTP 之下的数据报服务。UDP 本身不保证交付与去重。本执行包 B 已发出叶覆盖；这不是独立 RG 批准。

units.summaryEn: Source port, destination port, length and checksum identify the UDP datagram used by 615A. This is identity, not a claim that a particular stack is proven. Leaf coverage emitted this Package B increment; this is not independent RG approval.
units.summaryZh: 源端口、目的端口、长度与校验和标识 615A 所用 UDP 数据报。这是身份，不是某协议栈已获证明。本执行包 B 已发出叶覆盖；这不是独立 RG 批准。

units.summaryEn: Port and checksum behaviour are the UDP fields 615A TFTP rides on. 664P3 may further restrict checksum handling on a Compliant network. Leaf coverage emitted this Package B increment; this is not independent RG approval.
units.summaryZh: 端口与校验和是 615A TFTP 所依赖的 UDP 字段。664P3 可在 Compliant 网络上进一步限制校验和处理。本执行包 B 已发出叶覆盖；这不是独立 RG 批准。

units.summaryEn: The RFC 768 user-interface sketch is not a 615A actor obligation.
units.summaryZh: RFC 768 的用户接口简述不是 615A 参与者义务。

units.summaryEn: UDP assumes IP. IPv4 identity is RFC 791; host requirements remain RFC 1122 and NOT-ESTABLISHED. Leaf coverage emitted this Package B increment; this is not independent RG approval.
units.summaryZh: UDP 假定 IP。IPv4 身份是 RFC 791；主机要求仍是 RFC 1122 且 NOT-ESTABLISHED。本执行包 B 已发出叶覆盖；这不是独立 RG 批准。

units.summaryEn: Motivation and scope are not 615A actions.
units.summaryZh: 动机与范围不是 615A 动作。

units.clauseTitleEn: Overview and relation to other protocols
units.summaryEn: IPv4 is the network protocol under 615A UDP/TFTP on ordinary Ethernet. Leaf coverage emitted this Package B increment; this is not independent RG approval.
units.summaryZh: 在普通以太网中，IPv4 是 615A UDP/TFTP 之下的网络协议。本执行包 B 已发出叶覆盖；这不是独立 RG 批准。

units.summaryEn: Version, header length, total length, identification, flags, fragment offset, TTL, protocol and addresses are the IPv4 header 615A traffic uses. Leaf coverage emitted this Package B increment; this is not independent RG approval.
units.summaryZh: 版本、头长度、总长度、标识、标志、分片偏移、TTL、协议与地址是 615A 流量使用的 IPv4 头。本执行包 B 已发出叶覆盖；这不是独立 RG 批准。

units.summaryEn: 615A Data Loader fragmentation/reassembly is reconciled with this IPv4 mechanism. 664P3 profiled deviations cannot erase that 615A obligation. Leaf coverage emitted this Package B increment; this is not independent RG approval.
units.summaryZh: 615A 数据加载器分片/重组与此 IPv4 机制对账。664P3 的 Profiled 偏差不能抹去该 615A 义务。本执行包 B 已发出叶覆盖；这不是独立 RG 批准。

units.summaryEn: Gateway requirements are not 615A dataloading CRS.
units.summaryZh: 网关要求不是 615A 数据加载 CRS。

units.summaryEn: RFC 791 module interfaces are not 615A protocol files.
units.summaryZh: RFC 791 模块接口不是 615A 协议文件。

units.summaryEn: IP options are not adopted as 615A protocol options.
units.summaryZh: IP 选项未被采纳为 615A 协议选项。

units.clauseTitleEn: IP identity capability remains not established as a stack claim
units.summaryEn: Registering RFC 791 identity does not prove a host IP implementation. Leaf coverage emitted this Package B increment; this is not independent RG approval.
units.summaryZh: 登记 RFC 791 身份并不证明主机 IP 实现。本执行包 B 已发出叶覆盖；这不是独立 RG 批准。

units.summaryEn: Host-requirement introduction is not a 615A action.
units.summaryZh: 主机要求引言不是 615A 动作。

units.summaryEn: Link-layer host behaviour is an infrastructure premise behind Ethernet. It is not established by this audit. Leaf coverage emitted this Package B increment; this is not independent RG approval.
units.summaryZh: 链路层主机行为是以太网背后的基础设施前提。本审计不将其标为已建立。本执行包 B 已发出叶覆盖；这不是独立 RG 批准。

units.summaryEn: IPv4 host communication remains NOT-ESTABLISHED (existing NET-ISSUE-RFC1122 / NET-PREMISE-IPV4-UDP). Leaf coverage emitted this Package B increment; this is not independent RG approval.
units.summaryZh: IPv4 主机通信仍为 NOT-ESTABLISHED（已有 NET-ISSUE-RFC1122 / NET-PREMISE-IPV4-UDP）。本执行包 B 已发出叶覆盖；这不是独立 RG 批准。

units.summaryEn: UDP host requirements are the infrastructure under 615A TFTP. Capability IPV4-UDP-HOST-COMMUNICATION-SEMANTICS stays NOT-ESTABLISHED. Leaf coverage emitted this Package B increment; this is not independent RG approval.
units.summaryZh: UDP 主机要求是 615A TFTP 之下的基础设施。能力 IPV4-UDP-HOST-COMMUNICATION-SEMANTICS 仍为 NOT-ESTABLISHED。本执行包 B 已发出叶覆盖；这不是独立 RG 批准。

units.summaryEn: TCP is not used by 615A dataloading.
units.summaryZh: 615A 数据加载不使用 TCP。

units.summaryEn: References only.
units.summaryZh: 仅参考文献。

openIssues.noteEn: Host IPv4/UDP communication is still an unverified prerequisite, not a closed 1122 conformance claim.
openIssues.noteZh: 主机 IPv4/UDP 通信仍是未验证前提，不是已闭合的 1122 符合性主张。

units.summaryEn: Not a 615A action.
units.summaryZh: 不是 615A 动作。

units.summaryEn: Host names, DNS use and TOS are not 615A protocol files.
units.summaryZh: 主机名、DNS 使用与 TOS 不是 615A 协议文件。

units.summaryEn: Telnet is not 615A dataloading.
units.summaryZh: Telnet 不是 615A 数据加载。

units.summaryEn: FTP is not 615A TFTP.
units.summaryZh: FTP 不是 615A TFTP。

units.summaryEn: RFC 1123 §4.2 adds host TFTP notes: octet/netascii modes, UDP header, Sorcerer's Apprentice, timeout, extensions, access control and broadcast RRQ. 615A uses octet TFTP with its own option set; mail/netascii and broadcast-RRQ are not adopted. Sorcerer's Apprentice remains a TFTP-base constraint alongside RFC 1350. Leaf coverage emitted this Package B increment; this is not independent RG approval.
units.summaryZh: RFC 1123 §4.2 补充主机 TFTP 说明：octet/netascii、UDP 头、术士学徒、超时、扩展、访问控制与广播 RRQ。615A 使用带自有选项集的 octet TFTP；不采用 mail/netascii 与广播 RRQ。术士学徒与 RFC 1350 同为 TFTP 基础约束。本执行包 B 已发出叶覆盖；这不是独立 RG 批准。

units.summaryEn: SMTP is unused.
units.summaryZh: 不使用 SMTP。

units.summaryEn: DNS and remote management are unused.
units.summaryZh: 不使用 DNS 与远程管理。

units.summaryEn: References only.
units.summaryZh: 仅参考文献。

units.summaryEn: TFTP transfers files over UDP. 615A uses this base with 615A-defined files and options. Leaf coverage emitted this Package B increment; this is not independent RG approval.
units.summaryZh: TFTP 经 UDP 传文件。615A 在此基础上使用自有文件与选项。本执行包 B 已发出叶覆盖；这不是独立 RG 批准。

units.summaryEn: Lock-step RRQ/WRQ, DATA, ACK and ERROR are the TFTP exchanges 615A file transfer uses. Leaf coverage emitted this Package B increment; this is not independent RG approval.
units.summaryZh: 锁步 RRQ/WRQ、DATA、ACK 与 ERROR 是 615A 文件传输使用的 TFTP 交换。本执行包 B 已发出叶覆盖；这不是独立 RG 批准。

units.summaryEn: TFTP runs on UDP. IP/UDP identities are separate RFCs. Leaf coverage emitted this Package B increment; this is not independent RG approval.
units.summaryZh: TFTP 运行于 UDP。IP/UDP 身份是独立 RFC。本执行包 B 已发出叶覆盖；这不是独立 RG 批准。

units.summaryEn: RRQ/WRQ and TID assignment are the connection start 615A TFTP uses. Mail mode is not used. Leaf coverage emitted this Package B increment; this is not independent RG approval.
units.summaryZh: RRQ/WRQ 与 TID 分配是 615A TFTP 的连接起点。不使用 mail 模式。本执行包 B 已发出叶覆盖；这不是独立 RG 批准。

units.summaryEn: RRQ, WRQ, DATA, ACK and ERROR packet layouts are the TFTP packet types. Option acknowledgements come from RFC 2347, not this section. Leaf coverage emitted this Package B increment; this is not independent RG approval.
units.summaryZh: RRQ、WRQ、DATA、ACK 与 ERROR 是 TFTP 包类型。选项确认来自 RFC 2347，不是本节。本执行包 B 已发出叶覆盖；这不是独立 RG 批准。

units.summaryEn: Short final DATA block terminates a 615A TFTP transfer. Leaf coverage emitted this Package B increment; this is not independent RG approval.
units.summaryZh: 短最后 DATA 块结束 615A TFTP 传输。本执行包 B 已发出叶覆盖；这不是独立 RG 批准。

units.summaryEn: ERROR aborts the TFTP transfer. This is TFTP-layer abort, not a waiver of 615A FIND 2 s / 3 s clocks. Leaf coverage emitted this Package B increment; this is not independent RG approval.
units.summaryZh: ERROR 中止 TFTP 传输。这是 TFTP 层中止，不是对 615A FIND 2 秒/3 秒时钟的豁免。本执行包 B 已发出叶覆盖；这不是独立 RG 批准。

units.summaryEn: Mail mode is not used by 615A.
units.summaryZh: 615A 不使用 mail 模式。

openIssues.noteEn: CRS-M1-00418..00424 still list RFC-1350 as NOT-YET-BOUND. Package B must emit explicit edges or keep named non-edge with rationale.
openIssues.noteZh: CRS-M1-00418..00424 仍将 RFC-1350 列为 NOT-YET-BOUND。执行包 B 必须给出显式边，或保留具名无边及理由。

units.summaryEn: RFC 1785 is Informational. It does not specify an Internet standard and adds no 615A actor obligation.
units.summaryZh: RFC 1785 为 Informational，不规定因特网标准，也不增加 615A 参与者义务。

units.clauseTitleEn: Behaviour of servers that ignore options
units.summaryEn: Test narrative about legacy servers. 615A already says an unimplemented option must not fail the transfer; that obligation stays on 615A, not on this RFC.
units.summaryZh: 关于遗留服务器的试验叙述。615A 已规定未实现选项不得使传输失败；该义务在 615A，不在本 RFC。

units.summaryEn: Option negotiation is the mechanism 615A uses when TFTP options are present. Unimplemented options must not fail the transfer (615A), consistent with this extension. Leaf coverage emitted this Package B increment; this is not independent RG approval.
units.summaryZh: 当存在 TFTP 选项时，615A 使用该选项协商机制。未实现选项不得使传输失败（615A），与此扩展一致。本执行包 B 已发出叶覆盖；这不是独立 RG 批准。

units.summaryEn: OACK is the option-acknowledgement packet. 615A does not invent a different option packet type. Leaf coverage emitted this Package B increment; this is not independent RG approval.
units.summaryZh: OACK 是选项确认包。615A 不另造选项包类型。本执行包 B 已发出叶覆盖；这不是独立 RG 批准。

units.summaryEn: Options append to RRQ/WRQ. Only blksize, timeout and tsize are adopted from 2348/2349 plus any 615A-defined integrity option. Other options stay unimplemented and non-fatal. Leaf coverage emitted this Package B increment; this is not independent RG approval.
